items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Harris, who lives in Baltimore.

ctx.x: Charlie Harris, who lives in Baltimore. The reason I got to play with so many different bass players is because of playing the tuba. I was listening to one thing, "Once In A While," where Billy May had me featured behind Nat Cole; I was playing like an obbligato on the tuba to the bridge of "Once In A While." And that happens to be one of my favorite things. "Once In A While," incidentally, happens to be the first record I ever made, and that was with Louis Armstrong on Decca. That was in 1937, when I played with…
You really started at the top, right?
